# Upstream memory backports for Bazel 9.3

This batch replaces downstream dictionary compaction (`a5463c6f80`) with upstream
provider dictionary/set compaction and its prerequisites. The replacement uses
`CompactImmutableDict` and the `Compactable` interface. The dictionary regression
tests from bazelbuild/bazel#31075 remain included.

## Compatibility adaptations

- Keep the 9.3 `net.starlark.java.types` imports and `repr(Printer)` API.
- Keep the 9.3 provider lookup implementation while adding `Compactable`.
- Adapt `Resolver` globals sharing to the 9.3 function metadata and switch syntax.
- Intern the existing single-field build-settings key without adding host flags.

## Review scope

ResourceSet, execution-info, Merkle-tree, remote ByteString, and repository
map optimizations were already backported. Provider-instance and NestedSet
interning series were excluded because they require larger sequences of
serialization/equality fixes. No aggregate memory or performance measurement
was made for this batch.
